sources.title: Exact Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT model card
sources.evidence: Exact variant is an AI Singapore instruction fine-tune of Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B using Gemma 3 architecture; Gemma license; text/image input; text output; function calling. Training affected the text back-end. No dedicated thinking mode is documented.

sources.title: Exact released checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Fetched directly after browser extraction failed. Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration; gemma3_text with 62 layers, width 5376 and intermediate size 21504; SigLIP vision encoder; BF16. No expert routing configuration. max_position_embeddings is omitted and uses the library default.

sources.title: SEA-LION v4: Our First Multimodal Release, Open, Powerful & Small
sources.evidence: Announcement dated August 25, 2025 explicitly names and links Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT, labels it 27 billion parameters, gives 128K context, and states function-calling support and immediate weight availability.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint repository and tensor metadata
sources.evidence: At revision c41c291558bdd8cbc37d77868cec0bc5b6921476, safetensors metadata reports 27,432,406,640 BF16 parameters. Repository creation is August 11, 2025, which is not the public release date.

sources.title: Published checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Index records 1,247 tensors and total_size 54,864,813,280 bytes, consistent with 27,432,406,640 BF16 parameters including the vision component.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: The inherited Gemma 3 27B IT backbone is explicitly classified Dense in Table 5; section 2 describes a decoder-only Transformer with local/global attention and a SigLIP vision encoder.

sources.title: Transformers 4.50.0 Gemma 3 configuration implementation
sources.evidence: Gemma3TextConfig defaults max_position_embeddings to 131072; Gemma3Config constructs that class from the text_config dictionary. This establishes the exact default used by the checkpoint configuration, whose producer identifies 4.50.0.dev0.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint tokenizer and conversation template
sources.evidence: Template accepts alternating user/assistant turns with text/image content. It defines no distinct reasoning-output channel or thinking control; absence is insufficient to prove no reasoning capability.

developer.note: Card attributes development to AI Products Pillar, AI Singapore.

family.note: Exact variant retains the Gemma 3 architecture.

release_date.note: Dated original developer announcement explicitly offers this IT model. September 23 in the baseline is contradicted; repository creation is not substituted for release.

open_weights.note: Released downloadable checkpoint; license is Gemma Terms of Use.

license.note: Exact model-card license identifier is gemma.

parameters_b.note: Total published tensor count is 27,432,406,640, divided by 1e9. Includes vision parameters. Developer marketing label 27B is nominal; baseline 27 is not an exact whole-model tensor count.

active_parameters_b.note: Dense multimodal model; no separate active-per-token count is reported. Do not equate all stored text/vision weights with parameters active on every token.

architecture.note: Exact fine-tune uses Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration with dense Gemma 3 text decoder and SigLIP vision encoder. This conclusion is tied to its own configuration and documented lineage.

context_window.note: Developer states 128K. Exact configuration omits max_position_embeddings, so the declared Gemma3TextConfig implementation supplies 131072. Baseline 128000 is the decimal shorthand rather than the configured token limit.

modalities.note: Exact IT model retains vision input despite SEA training being text-only; it is distinct from the later v4-27B-VL fine-tune.

reasoning.note: The model is trained/evaluated on reasoning and mathematics, but no dedicated thinking mode or separate reasoning channel is established. Neither false nor true as a reasoning-model capability flag is verified.

tool_call.note: Exact IT card and launch announcement explicitly claim function calling. This is the model capability; individual hosted endpoints may impose restrictions.

description.value: Gemma 3 27B tuned by AI Singapore for Southeast Asian languages and instruction following
description.note: Concise baseline description accurately characterizes the exact fine-tune.

patch.notes: 27B is the developer's nominal size; published BF16 tensor metadata totals 27.43240664B including vision. Dense architecture has no separately reported active-per-token count. 128K resolves to 131072 positions in the Gemma 3 configuration. Dedicated reasoning-mode support is unverified; ordinary reasoning tasks do not establish a thinking-model flag.

summary: Confirmed exact IT fine-tune lineage and multimodal weights. Correct release to 2025-08-25, Gemma license, dense architecture, function calling, and configured 131072 context. Record exact 27.43240664B total tensor count while retaining nominal 27B interpretation in notes. Active count remains null; dedicated reasoning flag remains unverified rather than asserted false.
